svg.title: Select outputs to find their common inputs
svg.desc: One block owns the upper-left 4 × 4 region of a larger 8 × 8 output C. Find the first four rows of A and first four columns of B, each of length 8. Orange, blue and purple distinguish selected outputs and inputs. Bring common inputs from global to shared memory. Value a from row 0 of A serves four outputs in row 0; value b from column 0 of B serves four outputs in column 0. Outlines mark the output row and column reusing an input. Outputs are not depicted as stored in shared memory. Input chunking and partial-sum accumulation are not shown here. A tile is a rectangular region computed together, not a recommended tile or actual block size.
